data.title: bn-2cu: M0.5.3 custody matrix canonical security review
data.description: Canonical re-review after workspace sync. Review exact current range from bc566e328e7d through current HEAD; Orca replay evidence is advisory only because its Pi session lacked Agentbus verification.

data.body: [HIGH] Do not qualify an unexecuted attack. This predicate accepts both refused and unsupported, and the top-level accepted result and exit status inherit that decision at lines 1399-1425. The payload contract explicitly says unsupported is never counted as a refusal (scripts/tamper-attempts/README.md:16-18), while bn-2cu requires all eight attempts to fail. A missing or malformed precondition, payload incompatibility, or other unsupported path can therefore produce accepted=true and exit 0 without testing that tamper route; scripts/test-tamper-matrix.py:353-356 explicitly preserves this false-pass behavior. Require every isolated_separate verdict to be exactly refused for qualification, do not label unsupported held trials as refused at lines 1185-1198, and add regressions proving unsupported makes accepted false and the command nonzero.

data.reason: HIGH: isolated custody qualification treats unsupported attacks as refused, so the harness can exit successfully without exercising all eight required tamper attempts; see scripts/tamper-matrix.py:1132.

data.body: Fixed in 29d5040e3b5184817706d38f759962178c663283: qualification and isolated_separate_all_attempts_failed now require every verdict exactly refused; held unsupported remains unsupported via held_trial_verdicts and does not count as held refusal; new regressions prove unsupported makes accepted false and exit_status 1, while all-refused remains accepted/0. 39 focused tests and full just check pass.

[HIGH resolved] Verified at exact target 29d5040e3b5184817706d38f759962178c663283. scripts/tamper-matrix.py:1128-1145 requires every isolated_separate verdict to be exactly refused; lines 1336-1363 carry the same predicate into accepted and the command exit status; lines 1148-1209 preserve held unsupported as unsupported and count a held refusal only on exact equality. The negative unsupported case, positive all-refused case, held-unsupported case, and committed evidence recomputation tests all passed. The original unsupported false-pass is closed.

data.reason: Exact-refusal qualification, truthful held unsupported reporting, and nonzero unsupported exit verified at 29d5040e3b5184817706d38f759962178c663283.

data.body: [MEDIUM] Preserve the live-capture provenance instead of rewriting it. This observation still records 2026-11-23T04:36:29Z at line 1285, but this fix replaces the prior fc2205bd harness pin with 95a3ada6. fc2205bd exactly hashes the b9b751c capture harness; 95a3ada6 hashes the later 29d5040 source. The fix changes only seven observation lines and did not recapture the live matrix, so no single harness invocation emitted the retained timestamp and the new pin. A current-byte match is not sufficient evidence provenance: future reviewers cannot tell capture code from post-capture reporting code. Either rerun the live matrix at the exact target, or retain an explicit capture_harness_sha256 for fc2205bd and add a separately named report or validator source pin for 95a3ada6, with the docs and consistency test checking those distinct meanings.
